title: 🍻 2026 Fall Semester Opening Gathering & Dinner
author: Admin
content:
## 🍻 2026 Fall Semester DxH Research Group Opening Gathering & Dinner

- **Date & Time**: Wednesday, September 2, 2026, 18:00
- **Location**: Near Chungbuk National University
- **Attendees**: All members of CBNU DxH Research Group (DM Lab & HCI Lab)
- **Agenda**: Welcoming new researchers, sharing research goals for the Fall 2026 semester, and social networking.

title: 🧳 1st Data Intelligence × Human-Computer Interaction Workshop @ UNIST
author: Admin
content:
## 🧳 1st Data Intelligence × HCI Joint Workshop @ UNIST

- **Date**: July 15, 2026
- **Location**: UNIST (Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology)
- **Participants**: CBNU DxH Research Group (DM Lab & HCI Lab) & UNIST Research Collaborators
- **Topic**: Interdisciplinary seminars and collaborative research discussions on Human-AI Interaction & Data Intelligence.
